NAME:
   rancher - rancher-cli

USAGE:
   rancher [global options] [command [command options]]

VERSION:
   v-test

COMMANDS:
   access:          Which clusters a subject can reach, which projects it can see into, and what it can do, as the server answers (never inferred from bindings)
   app:             Install a chart from a repository as an app, upgrade an app, or uninstall an app (list charts with `rancher charts`, read apps with `rancher get app`)
   auth:            Auth commands
   charts:          List the charts and versions the repositories of a cluster offer
   cluster:         Scale a machine pool, manage cluster-autoscaler settings, upgrade the Kubernetes version of a cluster, set its upgrade strategy, take an etcd snapshot or restore a cluster from one (create a provisioning cluster with `rancher create cluster` and delete it with `rancher delete provisioning-cluster`)
   completion:      Print a shell completion script (ignores -o; always the raw script)
   config:          Config commands
   create:          Create resources
   delete:          Delete resources
   extension:       Add a Rancher extension repository; list, install, upgrade and uninstall Rancher UI extensions
   get:             Get resources
   grant:           Grant a role to a user or group at project, cluster, or global scope
   images:          List container images in use, grouped by image or owning workload
   inspect:         Inspect a cluster, workload or project with its related objects
   kubeconfig:      Print an exec-credential kubeconfig for a cluster, with its direct endpoint contexts when the cluster has them
   logs:            Show logs of Rancher components (server, agent, fleet-agent, kube-api-auth, webhook, api-extension)
   node:            Drain a node of a cluster or stop a drain (read nodes with `rancher get node --cluster <cluster>` and the drain state with `rancher get management-node --cluster <cluster>`)
   oidc-client:     [Prime] Manage OIDC client secrets (`rancher create oidc-client` creates the client itself)
   patch:           Patch resources
   project:         Project namespace commands (project membership is managed with `rancher grant` and `rancher revoke`)
   revoke:          Revoke a subject's role(s) at project, cluster, or global scope
   schema:          Print the schema manifest, optionally filtered to one command
   skill:           Install, remove and check the agent skills that come with rancher-cli
   support-bundle:  Collect diagnostics reachable through the API into one tar.gz for support
   telemetry:       Local usage recording: status, turn on, turn off, delete, list and send events
   token:           Legacy exec-credential shim for Rancher-generated kubeconfigs
   usage:           Show CPU/memory requests, limits, and usage for namespaces, projects, nodes, or pods

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --help, -h                  show help
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --project string            the project, by id or display name, on the cluster given by --cluster (only commands that take --project accept it)
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --version, -v               print the version
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
